analytical_execution_model: analytical measurement model: finite-shot binomial circuit outcomes; no QPU execution and no statevector simulation runtime

bootstrap_protocol.slope_resampling: joint replicate identifiers are resampled once and reused across every preregistered budget; a slope resample is invalid if any RMSE is zero

confidence_interval_methods.analytical_mlae: audit_fixed_grid_likelihood_ratio_envelope_not_qiskit_ci; envelope of all fixed amplitude-grid points passing the one-parameter LR cutoff

cost_model.circuit_depth: maximum quantum-operation depth among separately transpiled schedule circuits; all-to-all analysis with no backend target or coupling map
cost_model.classical_monte_carlo_calls: one deterministic 64-entry table lookup per sample; exactly matched to realized logical_lookup_oracle_calls for MLAE
cost_model.exact_enumeration_calls: 64 deterministic reads, one for every entry in the finite oracle domain
cost_model.gate_count: u/cx basis quantum gates only; barrier and measurement excluded; max, schedule sum, and shot-weighted schedule sum reported separately; all-to-all analysis with no backend target or coupling map
cost_model.logical_lookup_oracle_calls: shots_per_circuit * sum(2*k + 1); counts executed logical U_f and U_f^-1 applications, including the leading state preparation
cost_model.shots: measurement repetitions; never used as an alias for oracle calls

finite_domain_fairness.interpretation: Exact enumeration has zero error after N=64 logical table reads. Every QAE/MC cell records requested_budget_ge_domain_size and realized_calls_ge_domain_size; M>=N cells cannot establish an advantage over the exact finite-domain classical control.

non_claims: Analytical measurement-model runtime is not QPU or simulator runtime.
StatevectorSampler runtime is classical CPU simulation, not physical-QPU runtime.
The lookup truth table is classically specified; this is not reversible ray marching.
No practical quantum speed-up or hardware result is inferred from this bundle.

outlier_policy.raw_archive: every successful, failed, and warmup record is retained; captured runtime warnings remain attached to their raw records
outlier_policy.summary_exclusions: only records explicitly marked warmup are excluded by design; failed records without a valid metric are separately counted and never silently imputed

plot_protocol.byte_reproducible: PNG and PDF outputs are deterministic for identical raw/config inputs; PDF wall-clock creation/modification metadata is disabled
plot_protocol.slope_definition: ordinary least squares of log(RMSE) on log(realized calls) over every preregistered budget for one method/amplitude; undefined if any full-range point is missing or nonpositive
plot_protocol.uncertainty: deterministic 95% percentile-bootstrap bands for bias, RMSE, sample standard deviation, and operational-method runtime median

runtime_execution_model: Qiskit StatevectorSampler finite-shot CPU simulation of synthesized circuits; not a QPU

runtime_order_protocol.method: warmup and measured pair units are separately deterministically shuffled; adjacent MC/Qiskit order alternates, giving exact phase balance when the number of pair units is even

runtime_warning_messages: RuntimeWarning: divide by zero encountered in scalar divide

statistical_metric_definitions.mean_estimate: arithmetic mean of successful replicate estimates
statistical_metric_definitions.rmse: square root of the mean squared error against the exact amplitude
statistical_metric_definitions.sample_variance: unbiased replicate-estimate variance with denominator n-1

timer_definitions.analysis_copy_transpilation_ms: after the operational method timer, construct and optimization_level=0 transpile resource-analysis circuit copies without a backend target/coupling map
timer_definitions.audit_end_to_end_ms: all explicitly executed audit phases for one runtime record, including the audit-only resource-analysis transpilation; excludes raw-file serialization and manifest collection
timer_definitions.confidence_interval_postprocessing_ms: method-specific confidence-interval call after the estimator timer; Qiskit likelihood-ratio for MLAE and Wilson score for MC
timer_definitions.estimator_runtime_ms_exact: Python sum over all 64 supplied table entries
timer_definitions.estimator_runtime_ms_mc: seeded table sampling and sample mean
timer_definitions.estimator_runtime_ms_qiskit: MaximumLikelihoodAmplitudeEstimation.estimate; includes primitive circuit handling, StatevectorSampler sampling, and MLE postprocessing
timer_definitions.import_costs: Python, Qiskit, and Matplotlib imports complete before every per-record timer and are excluded from audit_end_to_end_ms
timer_definitions.operational_method_runtime_ms: contiguous wall-clock runtime from a supplied table needed to return the method result: oracle synthesis, sampler/algorithm setup, estimator, and confidence interval for Qiskit; sampling plus Wilson interval for MC; summation for exact. Excludes the later audit-only analysis-copy transpilation.
timer_definitions.runtime_plot_metric: median operational_method_runtime_ms with deterministic percentile-bootstrap interval; estimator core, audit-only transpilation, and full audit end-to-end remain separately archived
timer_definitions.warmup_policy: warmup records are retained with warmup=true and excluded from runtime summary; they exercise lazy runtime initialization after imports and do not measure imports

truth_table_hash_encoding: SHA-256(bytes(table)); exactly one byte 0x00 or 0x01 per table index, in ascending index order
